claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The motivating paper allows the same underlying P but gives no fixed-u spectral infimum; Ran–Teng allow the same diagonal pattern but vary u and thus establish spectral possibility only at some u; Kirkland fixes u but allows nonzero diagonal, so does not enforce trace zero or fixed-circulation budget. In particular their conclusions do not give attainability of the 1/2 bound exactly for max u<=4/9; the abstract of Guerry addresses a distinct existential root objective, although uninspected full theorems could in principle contain intermediate coverage. Reversible FMMC papers cannot dominate the defect/Jordan and complex spectral trichotomy for nonreversible kernels. No decisive contrary published implication was identified.

originality.rationale: Recent mutation Q-process paper introduces same zero-diagonal P but not its optimal spectrum. Ran–Teng 2024 Proposition 6 covers the unrestricted-stationary eigenvalue region and thus the generic 1/2 spectral lower bound, which is not new; Kirkland 2023 covers fixed-stationary spectral regions with holding allowed and reversible cases. Neither implies sharp fixed-stationary no-holding 4/9 threshold. Reversible/symmetric FMMC results do not imply the nonreversible full concentration threshold and defect classification. Real published-finding corpus and literature queries revealed no equivalent strong coverage. Same-dimensional matrix root source full text unavailable remains a concrete novelty risk; the PASS is best-knowledge, not proof of absolute uniqueness.
residual_risks: Accessible summaries of published-finding corpus records and own historical titles/claims cannot prove complete uniqueness.
Ran–Teng 2024 already gives the zero-diagonal spectral-region theorem without the stationary constraint; no novelty is claimed for that unrestricted region or the general 1/2 trace bound.
Kirkland 2023 gives fixed-stationary spectral information without the zero-diagonal constraint; a deeper implication of its full general polytope theory remains possible.
Guerry 2022 same-dimensional complex-spectrum work could have an implicit special-case classification in inaccessible full text.
Other historical general spectral-transportation-polytope extremal results could imply this specialization.
The optimal spectral radius is not a guarantee of optimal finite-time total-variation distance.

value.rationale: Naturally motivated sharp all-π three-state classification of admissible mutation rates, including a discontinuity of attainable spectral geometry at max stationarity 4/9, unique optimal currents up to time reversal, and a defective boundary. Distinguishes asymptotic spectral convergence from short-horizon mixing. Precise concentration invariant relevant to no-self mutation, not arbitrary small example.
